text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle raced through her first three 
years in the Twinkle Series with 
brilliance, leaving behind a stellar track 
record.

As for what things were like around her, 
it had become especially lively lately—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Mirako~~!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, Hishi Miracle isn't here—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! Miracle-san, Miracle-san!! I 
came to see you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mirako... Miracle-san's Trainer too, 
Howdy♪ I'm Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly, and so you see! Miracle-san—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Your speed! Your running!! So So 
Cooooooool!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've watched so many of your races! It 
makes me so, so, EXCITIIIIING!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Foooooooo～～～～☆

Before I knew it, Taiki Shuttle had 
scooped K.S. Miracle up into her arms and 
began spinning round and round with sheer 
momentum!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: W-W-What?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm okay... just a little startled. 
...Um, Taiki?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, that makes me so happy. Did you 
come all this way just to tell me that?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeeeeeess!! I've got an idea!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The first ever sprint-division umamusume 
to be named Horse of the Year!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, maybe you really can make it 
come true♪

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, "Horse of the Year"... !?

The 'URA Awards,' presented once a year by 
the URA, the governing body of the Twinkle 
Series, to honor various outstanding 
achievements.

The URA Awards are divided into several 
categories, with the top-performing 
Umamusume in each being recognized—

Among them, the "Horse of the Year" award 
is granted only to the Umamusume who 
"displayed the most praiseworthy 
performance that year."

And... as it stands, a sprinter Umamusume 
being crowned "Horse of the Year" is—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"That's, um... quite an incredible story. 
However..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's so incredible that... I don't know. 
I'd never even thought about it before...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! Why? Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Not yet" is NOT the same as "Never"!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You can definitely do it, YES! After all, 
you are a "Miracle"! Am I wrong, YES?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let us DO that! No, since we're at it, 
race against ME!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Either me, or you! The very first Speed 
King, and "Horse Girl of the Year"!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: The very first...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha! I see, you're right...! 'Not yet' 
doesn't mean 'never,' huh?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If I could make a miracle like that 
happen... yeah. ...That would be amazing.

Right here!! In that case, how about 
something like this?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wah! Are you... Curren?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ It's super cute Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But today, it's not just cuteness~... I've 
brought some juicy info with me too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Are you interested in "Overseas Races"?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: O-Overseas...!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, becoming the Blitz King across the 
ocean too! Britain? Dubai? Or Hong Kong 
after all?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hong Kong in particular has a deep pool of 
local talent, and no Japanese Umamusume 
has ever won there yet, but—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Not yet"... isn't "never," huh.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"That's right♪ So what do you think? 
Starting to get interested?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you feel like checking the place 
out beforehand, just let me know!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Someone who says they want to support 
Curren's Road of Cute is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Believe it or not, they offered to charter 
a cute private jet with a dragon pattern 
for us♪

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, truly...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Truly... amazing, isn't it?

During the training that followed, we 
headed outside for a run, but—
choice_data_list: Alright, let's take a quick breather.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ………… Here—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We came here on a run before, didn't we? 
Together with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
After the second year's Sprinters 
Stakes... and before entering the Swan 
Stakes.
choice_data_list: Oh, come to think of it...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Do you remember? Trainer...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You talked to me before about what it 
means to "pass down stories," right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even if my story had come to an end back 
then, someone surely would have passed the 
legend down.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So truthfully, even that would be enough, 
but... ...If I were to wish for more, stay 
as healthy as you can. And also, a whole 
lot of it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"They said that if possible, they'd love 
to pass down tons of stories about it."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Can I... really add more?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Something that gets everyone talking. 
...Maybe aiming for Umamusume of the Year, 
just like Taiki said."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe try taking on overseas challenges, 
like Curren said.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Things might not go well, and I might not 
leave behind any results at all, but— even 
so.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"We really managed to pull that off, 
didn't we?" I wonder if I can become 
someone they can talk about like that... 
with fond, happy memories.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. If that were the case, it would 
be truly amazing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: It's truly amazing. But, does that mean—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, you did say that, didn't you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Back at the very beginning. When you 
signed a contract with me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: You mentioned it, right? That I'm—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I wouldn't mind if you were my first and 
last trainee."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Then, here's my request—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, maybe it's selfish of me? ...Yeah, 
it's selfish.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please. Don't let this be the first and 
the last time.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Please, put off your own end as far as 
possible. Keep it far, far away."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Because—I want to talk about it too!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to tell everyone so much 
about you. All of your wonderful 
qualities, how cute you are, how cool you 
are—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
How dependable you are, what I respect 
about you... All of it, more and more.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I want heaps of things to talk about. 
...Selfish as that may be.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Please let me brag on and on about just 
how amazing my Trainer is."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To be able to walk alongside someone like 
that, I really—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: That you were happy!
